caption: Street lights are seen through a glass of fizzy water, and they wobble and sparkle as bubbles rise through the glass.

sa.check: Street lights are seen through a glass of fizzy water.
They wobble and sparkle as bubbles rise through the glass.
The lights are steady when seen past the glass.

pc.expect: The lights themselves do not move; the wobble is through the glass only.
pc.fail: The lights move; or are wobbly past the glass; or a different set of lights appears.

pc.expect: The distortion changes with the rising bubbles and only then.
pc.fail: The view wobbles with no bubbles; or is steady while bubbles plainly rise; or the glass moves.
They sink; or hang; or go sideways.

pc.expect: The glass is rigid and the water liquid.
pc.fail: The glass bends; or the water is rigid; or goes opaque.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or bubbles appear from nowhere outside it.

pc.expect: The glass and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The glass changes shape; or the street rearranges; or the water changes colour.
